en: Grunt
Ugh, you again?! I really hate it when people won't let things go!
Hmm... if I keep running this way, there's nobody to back me up. I'd better head for the sea!
So with that settled... I'm running away again! Goodbye, Virbank City!
{rival}
Well, they're good at running away, I'll give them that...
But she just told us something useful! They must be getting around by boat.
Castelia City has a big port. Maybe they headed there!
Right! Back to Virbank, {player}. Someone at the docks must know about ships. There was a place to board them, I'm sure of it.
Hiker
Hold it! A kid without a single Gym Badge, heading on past here? Not on my watch!
Battle the Trainers and Pokémon round here, then battle some more. Come back with a Badge!
Hiker
Hey! That shiny thing is the Basic Badge! Don't let it go to your head. It's a rough world out there!
Let me show you just how rough!
All right, I'm beaten! With Pokémon you can count on like that, even a kid can hold their own.
Cheren
{player}! Wait!
Come with me, you two.
See the darker grass here? Now and then two Pokémon jump out of it at once.
And the Pokémon that live in it can be quite rare. Keep your eyes open.
If you're going to challenge the next Gym, that's Virbank's. These might help.
And some for you too, {rival}. Both of you, do your best! If you need anything, come and find me.
{rival}
Cheren really knows his stuff. And he's fought Team Plasma, too...
That's it, I've decided! I'm going to get stronger than him!
And you... do your best! Fill up that Pokédex, and watch my back. Got it?
Hiker
The grass round here hides all sorts of Pokémon. Some of them even drop out of the trees!
You've got a good team there. Mind you look after them on the road to Virbank!
{rival}
I have to get stronger than Team Plasma!
{player}! Help me search Route 20! One of those grunts ran this way, I know it.
Cheren
Two Pokémon from one patch of grass. Make sure your team is ready for it.
